hypotheses.paper: M_0 GH singular flat, M_1, M_2 Cauchy extensions
hypotheses.note: Dev over an abstract Geometry (DEC-60, Level A); [ConnectedSpace M_0] carried as in packages 4 and 6

hypotheses.paper: the MCGHD morphism is an isometric embedding (Sbierski)
hypotheses.note: InjOn mcghdMap mcghdOpens carried; discharged by a time function on N_1 (exists_ppcm_of_timeFunction, Lemma 3.3) - the interface need of packages 4/6, the queued timeFunction field

hypotheses.paper: minimality over common over-extensions with Cauchy embeddings M_i -> M
hypotheses.note: any morphisms of developments g_1, g_2; the factorisation is moreover unique (rigidity A1)

hypotheses.paper: the induced map ppcm -> M is a Cauchy embedding (ETT.tex:2329)
hypotheses.note: conditional conclusion, not a hypothesis of the paper: ETT.tex:2329 asserts that the descended map ppcm -> M is a Cauchy embedding; here the descended morphism exists and is unique unconditionally (ppcmDev_desc), and its injectivity is proved only under an extra hypothesis, a time function on ppcmStr hinj (ppcmDev_desc_injective, Lemma 3.3); that hypothesis is discharged by the queued timeFunction field, ppcmDev being a Dev
ppcmDev_unique: the competitor need only factor pairs of injective morphisms, not uniquely

findings: ETT.tex:2000-2002 says everything reduces to the Hausdorff property and l.2324 concludes 'it is a singular flat spacetime', but a Cauchy extension must be globally hyperbolic with i(Sigma) Cauchy, which does not follow from Hausdorffness and is not argued; it needs the causal convexity of pgcd in M_1 and of its image in M_2 (the exit/re-entry argument) and a diamond decomposition through Sigma. Proved here: ppcm_globallyHyperbolic, ppcm_isCauchySurface (design gap 'ppcm GH', l.2319-2325).

ETT.tex:2328-2329: 'a coprod b descends ... and yields a Cauchy embedding ppcm -> M' - the descent is proved (rigidity), but injectivity of the descended map is not argued (a(x) = b(y) must force x ~ y); here it follows from Lemma 3.3 given a time function on ppcm (ppcmDev_desc_injective).
The morphism ppcm -> M of the minimality is unique (rigidity), which ETT does not state; uniqueness up to equivalence then follows with no further argument (ppcmDev_unique).

hypotheses.note: glued along mcghdOpens / mcghdMap (package 4); the identification is exactly x ~ psi(x), x in U (ppcm_ι₁_eq_ι₂_iff)

hypotheses.paper: Cauchy embeddings M_1 -> M, M_2 -> M making the diagram commute
hypotheses.note: no structure is defined; a common over-extension is a development Q with morphisms of developments g_1, g_2 (commutation with M_0 is part of Dev.IsMorphism); injectivity asked only in ppcmDev_unique's minimality hypothesis

kb_proposals: Global hyperbolicity of a gluing is model-free: Causality.TwoPiece (absolutely minimal on top, overlap causally convex in each piece, relations agreeing on it) gives causal convexity of each piece in the whole (mem_of_le_top), causality, and a common Cauchy surface; PieceChart + CauchySide give the compact diamonds, including the mixed past-piece/future-piece case (CBG/Ppcm). Package 10's family gluing needs the family form of the same chain argument.

Do not identify a glued structure's causality with Gluing.causality: an injective structure morphism on top is a PieceChart of its image (pieceChart_of_isMor, from the morphism and absolute minimality), which is all a causal argument reads.
Flat.LocalIso.rel_of_image now has three copies (Flat/FlatSpacetime, private in CBG/Pgcd and CBG/Ppcm): move it to a model-free module and delete the private copies.

J^-(S) closed for an acausal two-sided S (from K^- density and compact J^-(S) cap J^+(x)) is exported as Causality.isClosed_Jminus_of_dense; Corresponding's Jplus_mem_nhds_of_isAcausal proves it internally.
notes: Sorry-free, axiom-clean (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound), compiles with -DwarningAsError=true. Carried hypotheses: InjOn mcghdMap mcghdOpens (every theorem; or a time function on N_1, exists_ppcm_of_timeFunction), [ConnectedSpace M_0] (as packages 4/6), and a time function on ppcmStr hinj for ppcmDev_desc_injective only; the queued timeFunction field discharges both time-function needs (signature in interface_needs). No other new Geometry field is needed. On ppcm itself no curvesExtend / isCompact_* / secondCountable_of_cauchy is used (GH proved directly), so the package-10 risk of design section 6 does not arise for two developments; package 10 can consume exists_common_extension, or reuse TwoPiece/PieceChart for its family gluing after a family generalisation. The identification of the glued causality with Gluing.causality (Geometry's planned lemma for package 7) is discharged by replacement (pieceChart_of_isMor), see interface_needs. Witnesses (namespace Causal.Causality since the fix round): timelikeLine_twoPiece, timelikeLine_cauchySide, and the joint witness timelikeLine_twoPiece_globallyHyperbolic (PieceCharts a -> 1 - exp(-a)/2 and b -> exp(b)/2 with proper images, Cauchy sides {0} with common image {1/2}). The module is not yet imported by scaffold/CausalScaffold.lean (kb/0025: the master adds it). No ETT label marked.
